attributes.title: 2027 AAAAI Annual Meeting
attributes.cme_provider: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI); pharmacy CE with Amedco LLC (Joint Accreditation)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAAAI Annual Meeting runs February 19 to 22, 2027, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans. The program combines plenaries, a keynote, workshops with hands-on skills, demonstration stations and poster and oral abstract sessions; the basic-science conference Discovery 2027 runs alongside it on February 18 to 20.

In-person attendees can earn up to 38.25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, and pharmacists up to 23.75 knowledge-based CPE contact hours; recorded content stays available for credit through December 31, 2027. Members pay $570 through January 6, 2027 ($720 after), non-member physicians $820 ($970 after), and non-member nurses, NPs and PAs $500 ($600 after). Plenary topics include seafood allergy, patient-centered food allergy care, biologic non-response and machine learning in diagnostics.
